name: Copilot Proxy
author: Yujun Liu
description: Start and monitor copilot-proxy-api from the bar: GitHub sign-in, Copilot quota meters, and one-click wiring for Claude Code or Codex CLI.

barWidget.description: Run the GitHub Copilot bridge, watch premium-request quota, and point Claude Code or Codex at it.

schema.label: Proxy port
schema.description: Port the proxy listens on. Must match the systemd unit.

schema.label: Systemd user unit
schema.description: Name of the --user unit the widget starts and stops.

schema.label: Claude Code model
schema.description: Written to ANTHROPIC_MODEL. Also selectable from the panel.

schema.label: Claude Code small/fast model
schema.description: Written to ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL. Also selectable from the panel.

schema.label: Claude Code effort
schema.description: Written as `effort` in ~/.claude/settings.json. Default leaves the key out.

schema.label: Claude Code ultracode
schema.description: Written as `ultracode` in ~/.claude/settings.json. Orchestrates tasks with multi-agent workflows.

schema.label: Codex model
schema.description: Written as `model` in ~/.codex/config.toml. Also selectable from the panel.

schema.label: Codex reasoning effort
schema.description: Written as `model_reasoning_effort`. Also selectable from the panel.

schema.label: Hide the icon while the proxy is stopped
schema.description: Keeps the bar clean on machines where you rarely run the proxy.
